natural: All32 existing natural evaluation documents32–63; same cohort and tokens; report local write error, full-output KL, CE, top1 and support/code-energy.
training_diagnostic: One fixed pair per11trainingfamilies from M105 protocol, explicitly a diagnostic subset, not full training performance.
source_holdout: All14 source-group pairs, all eligible source/final sites and both endpoints.
whole_task_holdout: All56 whole-task pairs, all eligible source/final sites and both endpoints; report all7 and prespecified competent5 separately. These are reused development evaluations, not new tasks.
metrics: Intact reconstruction retention separately from native-background encoded donor-minus-recipient response fidelity. Report native-probability-weighted logprob response errors, margin error, local change error; both pooled and equal-family aggregates with native teacher energy retained.
magnitude_control: At each pair/site/endpoint, scale hard encoded delta to continuous encoded delta norm using candidate vectors only. Keep original hard and continuous conditions. Zero/zero is zero; hardzero/softnonzero explicitly ineligible. No gains tuned to teacher outcomes.
checks: Baseline and teacher replay against existing caches; independent code/decode/metric audits; exact sample coverage; no native unit/manifold claim from continuity alone.
stop: One fixed four-state adaptation and joint evaluation. No seed selection or additional training based on held-out results.
